shared: Art direction 'Gilded Lamplight': painterly semi-realism with visible oil-painting brushwork, deep warm shadows, amber candlelight, polished brass and dark oiled walnut, saturated jewel-tone stained glass in ruby, sapphire and emerald as the only cool accents. Clockwork automatons are slender and elegant: long limbs, segmented polished brass plates over dark gunmetal joints, a narrow head with two glowing amber eye slits, one glowing amber core in the chest. Card frames are tall portrait cards with an ornate brass frame, a circular illustration window in the upper two thirds, a parchment panel below and small corner medallions. Large readable forms and clean silhouettes, detail carried by surface texture and light rather than dense geometry. Original design. No text, no letters, no numbers on cards, no logos, no watermark.
